title: Preorder the Nopia ‘harmony machine’ synth on September 15th for $650.
summary: We finally got a real look at the viral Nopia in July after more than three years of development. Now the company is preparing to launch a Kickstarter campaign on Tuesday, with super early-bird pricing starting at $650.
